scope: Review-only actual complete LabQuadrotor source issuance and every constructor-issued exact assignment sequence; static coverage and direct Wasmi execution.

contract.authority: Existing continuous refresh owners and exact schedule identities; final_scalar_program from original implicit RHS. Every dispatch retained and each complete issued sequence compiled; membership deduplicates diagnostic execution only, preserving first-occurrence order.
contract.reference: Canonical eval_scalar_program_block_with_context with exact model pure-call and external tables, full Y/P/time; evaluate whole tuple before original ordered target commit. No filtered sequence, interpreter retry or synthesized source.
contract.comparison: Bit-exact all 262 Y scalars including untouched cells; full 192 P scalars immutable; entry guards unchanged. Source-issued layout binds complete state/control fixtures.
contract.engine: Actual Wasmi executing generated modules. Direct browser engine and ME adapter are not exercised by this gate.
contract.publication: Whole issued tuples commit in original target order. Focused late-fault, guarded-entry and tuple atomicity controls remain in separate verification record.

artifacts.fixtures: Per sequence/case input-y.bin,input-p.bin,expected-y.bin,actual-y.bin plus exact source/module digests and safe ABI/layout/math-import manifests.

limitations: 28 distinct admitted sequences include projection seed assignments; projection steps are not executed by this gate.

Individual complete sequences start from valid full fixtures; no full refresh, RK45 trajectory or event execution is claimed. Whole-refresh rollback remains separately owned.
Static coverage and preparation/test elapsed times are not runtime hit share or browser throughput.
Wasmi math imports bind canonical Rust functions; browser numerical qualification remains required.
Fresh same-build browser compiler activation, full-plant policy parity, runtime assignment coverage and physics profiling remain pending.
